content:
Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!

verses.text: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
notes: LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.
